text: The North Wind and the Sun once argued who was strong
Below, a traveler in a cloak came walking along
Who takes his cloak away, said the Wind, has won
The Wind blew hard, the pines bent low, the dust went flying
But the man held on tighter, the harder it was trying
Then the Sun came out and simply shone
The road grew warm, he wiped his brow
And took the cloak off on his own
Gentleness opens what force keeps shut
